claims.head: Don’t buy Skinner’s slump against the Stars
claims.body: Since 2023-24, Skinner has been shaky against the Stars, well below his usual. Fans love a pattern like this, but we checked three seasons of them and they predicted nothing. Don’t be surprised if he’s back to his usual self.
claims.nums: 7 starts against Dallas: .832 save percentage · .901 against everyone else
claims.gist: Don’t read much into Skinner’s record against the Stars.
claims.call: If Skinner starts, his save percentage lands closer to his usual .901 than to his .832 against the Stars.
claims.cite: Goalie starts since 2023-24 · 7 against Dallas, 4,135 shots against everyone else

claims.head: Where the Stars have the edge: shot quality
claims.body: The Stars are around the middle of the league for shot quality, and the Jets are one of the worst. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.

stakes: The Jets go in fifth in the Central with 10 points, a point behind the Stars, tied for third. A regulation win for the Jets would lift them past the Stars.

DAL.head: The Stars have a lot going for them
DAL.body: Dallas has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. The Jets can make it interesting if they keep shots to a minimum.
